justification: Both depict bearded men in strict profile facing right, with the very specific convention of hair and beard built from regular rows of tight curls or dots, a frontal eye in a profile head, a banded headdress, and dotted/rosette surface fill on garments \u2014 conventions unlikely to coincide by chance.
